title: Octanuclear Heterobimetallic {Ni4Ln4} Assemblies Possessing Ln Square Grid [2 × 2] Motifs: Synthesis, Structure, and Magnetism

material_class.structural_family: octanuclear Ni4Ln4 assembly with Ln4 [2×2] square grid

synthesis.procedure: All complexes 1–4 were prepared analogously. H5L (0.04 g, 0.1 mmol) was dissolved in MeOH/CHCl3 (40 mL). LnCl3·6H2O (0.1 mmol) was added, followed by Et3N (0.02 g, 0.2 mmol). The light yellow solution was stirred for 1 h. A methanolic solution (10 mL) of NiCl2·6H2O (0.024 g, 0.1 mmol) was then added, followed by a further two equivalents of Et3N (total Et3N 0.052 mL, 0.4 mmol for 1). The green-yellow mixture was stirred at room temperature overnight, evaporated in vacuo, washed twice with diethyl ether, dried, and redissolved in 1:1 v/v methanol/chloroform. Dark green X-ray-quality crystals of 1 formed by slow evaporation over about 10 days. Specific quantities for 1: H5L (0.04 g, 0.1 mmol), DyCl3·6H2O (0.038 g, 0.1 mmol), Et3N (0.052 mL, 0.4 mmol).

reagents.name: triethylamine
reagents.amount: 0.052 mL, 0.4 mmol (initially 0.02 g, 0.2 mmol plus two further equivalents)

synthesis.time: 1 h after first Et3N addition, then overnight after Ni addition; crystals after ~10 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution stirring at ambient temperature followed by solvent evaporation and recrystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: solvent stripped in vacuo; green residue washed twice with diethyl ether, dried, dissolved in 1:1 methanol/chloroform; dark green crystals by slow evaporation over about 10 days

properties.summary: Ferromagnetic Ni–Dy interactions (small χT peak below 5 K) and easy-axis Dy3+ anisotropy. Frequency-dependent ac signals below ~8 K in zero field, enhanced at μ0HDC = 0.14 T; field-induced SMM with QTM suppressed by dc field. Cole–Cole/Debye analysis at 2 K indicates a single relaxation pathway (α = 0.03(4)); Ueff not quantified.

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: evaporation in vacuo, diethyl ether wash, recrystallization from 1:1 methanol/chloroform by slow evaporation

properties.summary: χT decreases below ~100 K from Tb3+ thermal depopulation; further drop 10–5 K associated with Ni2+ crystal-field levels. No χT peak below 5 K, implying antiferromagnetic Ni–Tb exchange. Rounded χ maximum at 3.9(3) K. Weak χ'' at 0 and 0.1 T; strong frequency-dependent slow relaxation at μ0HDC = 0.59 T attributed to a field-induced level crossing (also seen as a rounded magnetization step near 0.6 T at 2 K), not QTM.

properties.summary: Magnetism dominated by easy-plane Ni2+ single-ion anisotropy DNi = 6.7(7) K (from dχ/dT minimum at 3.0(3) K) and Gd…Gd dipolar interactions that reduce the Gd contribution at low T. χT drops below 10 K. Magnetization ~25 μB/f.u. at 7 T and 2 K versus 36 μB expected for fully paramagnetic Ni2+/Gd3+. No SMM-like slow relaxation at 0 T; only very weak frequency dependence below 2.0 K in 0.1 T.
